subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu multi-account group sessions become account/app-scoped by default, and what migration or compatibility path should existing group sessions receive?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the likely fix changes durable session identity across message delivery, session state, and account authorization boundaries.

options.title: Scope group sessions by account/app
options.body: Make Feishu group session identity include the stable account/app boundary and add migration or doctor handling for existing accountless group sessions.

options.title: Add opt-in isolation
options.body: Keep existing shared group sessions by default and add an explicit Feishu account-scoped mode for multi-bot deployments.

options.title: Defer to broader Feishu identity work
options.body: Keep this issue open behind a wider multi-bot Feishu routing and session design rather than changing group keys now.

recommendation.title: Scope group sessions by account/app
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group session identity include the stable account/app boundary and add migration or doctor handling for existing accountless group sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu maintenance history makes this the best available owner for the Feishu-side behavior decision.
